library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-security-ojdbc-extensions implements Oracle JDBC's EndUserSecurityContextProvider SPI to propagate the authenticated Micronaut Security user's identity to DB connections via an OAuth2 client-credentials token fetch. All dependencies (ojdbc11, ojdbc-provider-common, micronaut-security-oauth2, etc.) are ordinary Maven Central artifacts already resolvable, and ojdbc11 is already supported in this repo's metadata. Upstream's own tests exercise the SPI registration, token-fetch HTTP flow, and role/attribute mapping using only an in-process embedded HTTP server as a mock OAuth2 endpoint — no live Oracle Database, no live OCI/IAM calls, no wallet/TNS_ADMIN files, and no Docker container are required for meaningful coverage.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Mirror upstream's test approach (micronaut-projects/micronaut-security, security-ojdbc-extensions module): stand up a local embedded Micronaut HTTP server/controller acting as a stub OAuth2 client-credentials token endpoint, then exercise ClientCredentialsClientDatabaseAccessTokenFetcher, MicronautEndUserSecurityContextProvider (SPI construction via META-INF/services), DefaultAttributesFetcher/DefaultDataRolesFetcher, and RolesUtils/JsonUtils against it. No live Oracle Database or OCI credentials are needed — this is testable entirely in-process.
